notes: WhaleChat 3.57.2 — the Appwrite site now connects to a dedicated WhaleChat sync function for cross-device accounts, chats, notifications, balances, trades and investments. The sync service and the full database snapshot live in Appwrite Storage (whalechat-state.json) and are restored automatically; polling replaces SSE on the function. Plus everything from 3.57.0: larger dashboard card with stocks-trade, WC-invest and vendor shortcuts; My account as the default screen; emailed 6-digit sign-up and password-reset codes; transaction PIN in Settings; per-plan green/red ROI charts; local stock charts offline; no offline banner over the tab bar; 10 Twelve Data stocks and 112 Binance pairs (162 markets); sell-only Auto Buy/Sell.
